heading: Wednesday, August 12, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Alibaba Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B and xAI Grok 4.6.

items.headline: Alibaba releases open weights for Qwen3.8-Max-class model
items.summary: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is the open-weight, text-only version of Qwen3.8-Max (2.4T total, 95B active parameters), released on Hugging Face and ModelScope. Its license requires providers with large annual revenue to obtain a commercial license; Qwen reports 67.7 on SWE-bench Pro.

items.headline: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.6
items.summary: Grok 4.6 builds on Grok 4.5 with stronger support for long-running agents and visual or interactive projects, at the same $2/$6 per million token pricing. The company reports it matches GPT-5.6 Sol at 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.
